rewrites.comment: React Router uses createBrowserRouter, so deep links like /app/results are client-side paths with no file on disk. Vercel serves a matching static file first and only falls through to this rule, so /assets/* is unaffected.

headers.comment: Vite fingerprints these filenames, so a changed file always gets a new URL and can be cached permanently.
index.html must never be cached, or a deploy leaves users on stale asset references.
